semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor test probes and sockets, which are critical for chip testing processes.
summary: Robotzone Intelligent Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the design and development of test probes, chip test sockets, and probe cards for the semiconductor industry. Their products are utilized by various large and medium-sized enterprises, providing efficient and reliable testing solutions.
capabilities: Precision test probes for semiconductor applications
Chip test sockets for various applications
Probe cards for efficient chip testing
Smart factory solutions for semiconductor manufacturing

regional_presence.China: The company is recognized as a Jiangsu Provincial High-tech Enterprise and serves both domestic and international markets.
